title: resolve: the call
description: Answers a question with the answerer's signed answer call, or withdraws it, the asker's cancel. For an accept or a change, the answer's text and the salt the answerer minted travel beside the call.

call.description: What is signed: the call's canonical bytes.

accord.description: The Accord id the caller expects the window to serve.

at.description: The caller's clock; the door refuses a call more than 60 seconds from its own (stale).

answer.description: The answer call, as the answerer signed it: a frozen format (spec/frozen-formats.md), carried as an object of its canonical bytes.

text.description: For an accept or a change: the answer's text, whose salted digest the call signs.

salt.description: For an accept or a change: the answer's salt, 32 bytes in lowercase hex.
